about_the_game:
Unnamed Arcade

Create. Survive. Earn.

A fully player-driven third-person shooter where you build the challenges, craft the rewards, and take on a growing world of user-created chaos.

 

About This Game

What if every level, every enemy, and every reward was created by players — including you?

 

Welcome to Unnamed Arcade, a sandbox-style third-person shooter powered by community creativity. Whether you’re a builder or a battler, you’ll find endless ways to play, create, and conquer.

 

Jump into player-made levels packed with traps, enemies, and custom objectives — or design your own. Using our intuitive world editor, you can quickly build exciting shooter challenges and assign custom rewards based on difficulty. The harder your level is, the more valuable the prize for beating it!

 

Create Your Own Challenges

-          Block-Based World Editor, Build your map block-by-block with ease — no coding required.

-          Unique Layer Tool Construct full levels quickly using a layer-based system that streamlines the building process.

-          Over 30 Block Textures, Customize the look and feel of your world with vibrant and detailed textures.

-          4 Enemy Types & 3 Trap Types, Add danger to your world and test players’ skills.

-          18 Different Weapons, Let players blast their way through your creations with a wide arsenal.

-          Player-Created Levels & Rewards, Every challenge and every unlockable reward is made by the community.

 

Challenge Others

Upload your creations and download others — all from the in-game server.

 

The Challenge System

Every enemy or trap you add increases the difficulty of your level. As the creator, you earn points to allocate toward the reward at the end. Tougher challenges offer bigger rewards — but only if players survive.

 

Can you build a challenge tough enough to earn respect ?

 

Key Features:

-          Block based world editor, build your world up block by block, very easy to use.

-          Unique layer tool, build your world up layer by layer to speed up the process.

-          Over 30 different block textures to customize how your world looks.

-          Player created levels

-          Player create rewards

-          Online server to share creations with other players.

 

New Updates

We're constantly improving the game thanks to feedback from our growing community!

 

-          New Blocks – Over 30 unique textures now available

-          10+ Playable Characters – Choose your favorite style

-          Upgraded Bullet Physics – Bullets bounce, arc, and react in wild new ways

-          Improved Movement – Faster sprinting, higher jumps, smoother game play

-          Randomly Generated Challenges – Play instantly with randomized worlds

-          Difficulty Settings – Choose Easy, Medium, or Hardcore for any challenge

 

Join the Project

Unnamed Arcade is a growing community-driven game. We’re actively updating, listening to player feedback, and building toward a bigger vision — and we want you to be part of it.

 

Create your challenge. Upload your world. Share your reward.

And most of all…

Try to Survive.
